notes.title: April Update – Game Progress Overview
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone!

It’s been a while since the last update, its time to fix that!
Development on Atrion Project is going well: most levels are now playable, the core systems are coming together, and the game world keeps growing steadily.

🎯 Here’s a visual overview of the current progress so you can see exactly where we’re at and what’s left before release:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44446990/5ea3470f11d4e8ed75a00854481a2876a653374c.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, feel free to drop your feedback on Discord or in the Steam discussions. I’d love to hear from you!  See you soon for more news and updates!  Cyril[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

I'm excited to share the latest update for the Atrion Project demo! This patch includes significant improvements, new features, and fixes inspired by your feedback. A special thank you to the amazing members of the Discord community who’ve helped track down bugs and provided invaluable suggestions. Your support means the world to me!

Patch Notes 

⚔️ Gameplay Enhancements
Added a teleportation system to quickly return to the start of a level.
The wake-up cutscene is now skippable for a smoother start.
Improved the hit feedback to make combat feel more satisfying.
Platforms now properly stop when the game is paused.
Introduced controller vibration for a more immersive experience.

🎮 Balance & Difficulty
Added a boss health bar for better fight clarity.
Adjusted tutorial difficulty in Easy Mode: the Firefly Queen now deals less damage.
Added a difficulty explanation pop-up in the main menu for better understanding.
Continued work on the power system—more features are on the way!

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug causing rapid health loss when HP is low.
Resolved an issue where players could pass through walls during a pause.
Fixed a problem with the ghoul enemy running on spikes.

✨ Visual and Sound Upgrades
New sword impact effects when hitting enemies.
Enhanced visual effects for basic attacks and the super blaster.
Added an impact sound for successful hits.
Introduced glow effects to enhance visuals.

🖥️ HUD & Interface
Improved dialogue boxes for better readability.
Upgraded the Atrion HUD for a cleaner look.
Enhanced visuals for the main menu.

🎞️ Animations
Atrion now has a special idle animation when waiting—keep an eye out!
Improved animations for level selection, bestiary reading, and idle sequences.

I hope you enjoy this update and the improvements it brings to the Atrion Project demo.

Your feedback is essential, so feel free to share more thoughts and suggestions in the community forums or on Discord.

Thank you for being part of this adventure!
Cheers !
